snippet.title: Cosmic Holidays - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Cosmic Holidays gameplay trailer for this upcoming hand-drawn 2D platformer game that takes you on a poetic journey across an unknown planet. Join Cibo, a small lost alien who can inflate his head to glide, bounce, roll, or absorb shocks. Cosmic Holidays will be available on PC.
